title: 申万宏源Edong：阿里AI投入获市场认可，长期价值凸显
speaker: Edong (guest)

segments.en: Well, I think that, just like I said before, at present, the core issue for the investors is not about the core businesses like e-commerce, like food delivery, these kind of things.
segments.zh: 正如我之前所说，目前投资者关注的核心问题不是电商、外卖等核心业务。

segments.en: I think the market focus shifted to how to enterprises, the AI CapEx, but now I think that, if you see in the long term, like R.D. like Tencent, these kind of leading names, they are still important players in AI fields, especially in China, but also maybe in the overseas market, these kind of companies.
segments.zh: 市场焦点转向AI资本开支。长期来看，阿里、腾讯等龙头在AI领域仍是重要参与者，不仅在中国，也可能在海外市场。

segments.en: And also some large model companies, they will rise their market shares in the overseas market. So actually, I think that it is the most important thing is that how to interpret the AI CapEx, but from my perspective, I think that it is a good benefit for them.
segments.zh: 一些大模型公司将在海外市场提升份额。最重要的是如何解读AI资本开支，我认为这对他们是利好。
